summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The npm preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses that freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` (~727 KB). `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle using a string-array rotator (`WV8StW`) over a ~1000-entry mixed constant array with hex-suffixed variable names; it is not imported anywhere in the package's documented entry point (`dist/index.js` only re-exports Cypress selector utilities) and has no legitimate role in a Cypress selector helper package. The obfuscated payload is invoked only via the preinstall's Bun exec path, so `npm install` auto-executes attacker-authored code on the installer's host under a runtime that Node-based tooling does not inspect. The package's advertised purpose (Cypress selectors) has no need for Bun or a large binary-executed payload; the combination of preinstall trigger, alternate-runtime loader, purpose mismatch, and heavy obfuscation of the executed bytes is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
